name: wu-editor
title: Wu
description: Open recent projects, files, and settings in Wu.
author: farshed

commands.name: open-recent-project
commands.title: Open Recent Project
commands.subtitle: Wu
commands.description: Search the projects you recently opened in Wu and open one.

commands.name: open-with-wu
commands.title: Open with Wu
commands.subtitle: Wu
commands.description: Open the files or folders selected in Finder, or the front Finder window's folder, in Wu.

commands.name: show-installed-extensions
commands.title: Show Installed Extensions
commands.subtitle: Wu
commands.description: List the extensions installed in Wu.

preferences.name: databasePath
preferences.title: Wu Database
preferences.description: Path to Wu's db.sqlite file. Only change this if you moved Wu's data directory.

preferences.name: cliPath
preferences.title: Wu CLI
preferences.description: Path to the wu command line tool. When missing, the copy bundled inside Wu.app is used.

preferences.name: configDir
preferences.title: Wu Config Directory
preferences.description: Folder holding Wu's settings.json and keymap.json.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
